all_feed.description: Every consecutive pair of collected last-traded-price observations for a market in the snapshot whose absolute change is >= swing_threshold_dollars, in either direction. Same rule as the dashboard feed (dashboard.html, renderAlerts).

high_roi.description: EXPERIMENTAL SCREEN, NOT AN ROI MODEL. Identical to the dashboard's 'Model watch' filter: category_basis == 'seed' (series in the official fee schedule) and volume_24h_fp > 0. The owner's model was not supplied (F-14).
high_roi.decided_at: detection time — build_alerts.py applies this screen to the snapshot it is reading and the archive is append-only, so the flag is a record of that moment and is never relabelled later. validate_alerts.py therefore checks each flag against the volume_24h_fp / category_basis stored with the alert, and reports disagreement with the current snapshot as drift (volume_24h_fp legitimately changes between collections) instead of failing the collector — see F-34 and scripts/tests/test_alerts.py HighRoiFreezeTests.

sources.price_observations: data/live/price_history.json (written by scripts/collect.py from GET /markets last_price_dollars)
